map.需求收入弹性 E_i = 需求量变动率 ÷ 收入变动率 =（ΔQ ÷ Q）÷（Δ: Income elasticity of demand E_i = rate of change in quantity demanded ÷ rate of change in income = (ΔQ ÷ Q) ÷ (ΔI ÷ I); the arc elasticity form (ΔQ ÷ average quantity) ÷ (ΔI ÷ average income) can also be used. E_i above 1 means a luxury, 0 to 1 a necessity, 0 a neutral good and below 0 an inferior good; an elasticity above 1 means demand grows faster than income, which helps forecast how income changes reshape consumption.
map.收入上升需求上升 → 正常品（正）。: Rising income with rising demand means a normal good (positive).
map.负值为劣等品。: A negative value means an inferior good.
map.品类判断：录入量价(收入)变动，算收入弹性，正为正常品。: Category test: enter the quantity and income changes and compute income elasticity; positive means a normal good.
map.消费结构：对比必需品与奢侈品弹性差异。: Consumption structure: compare the elasticity difference between necessities and luxuries.
map.教学演示：演示奢侈品弹性>1、必需品 0–1、劣等品为负。: Teaching demo: show that luxuries have elasticity above 1, necessities 0–1 and inferior goods a negative value.
map.示例：收入涨 10%、需求涨 15%，收入弹性=1.5>1，为奢侈品（需求增更快: Example: income rises 10% and demand rises 15%, so income elasticity = 1.5 > 1, a luxury (demand grows faster).
